title: 第4章 得草，寒瑛月魄
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“成亲赌约？”

赤火夫人面露讶色，先是对这四字不解，但当她看到陆玄垂首下铮铮明亮的眸子，心中却隐约有了一个猜测。

不过她并未说出自己的猜测，只是问道：“此乃何意？”

陆玄再行一礼，坦然对赤火夫人说道：“回夫人，陆玄实不愿就此失败，转修金甲玉躯，故此想以此身皮囊，和夫人立一份赌约。”

“我以此身，换取夫人一株【四相蓍草】，重开炼炁大醮。”

“天恩无二，此次若是失败，必有灾祸降下，我修为散去，此身再无一丝修行之可能，但炼炁毕竟是修行第一醮，性命当可保全，肉身无虞。”

“若是失败，我愿以残身，入狐族为婿，直到寿终。”

“若是功成，则以厚报还恩。”

陆玄语气铿锵，显然是早有腹案，下定了决心。

残躯之身，还想入狐族为婿，还要提前求取一株四相蓍草？

若是旁人，赤火夫人早就将其轰了出去，但看着眼前起身站立，如芝兰玉树的少年，她却只是长叹劝道：“何至于此？”

“仙教采炁之法，乃是天地正炁，蕴意于炁之中，非炁感灵妙者，不得采……”

“金甲玉躯之法，亦可得二百六十载寿元，得入仙教门墙，再有吾女为伴，神仙眷侣，岂不快哉？”

“何必行险至此？”

她寿元悠久一些，故此对仙教了解更深。

【四相蓍草】之所以成为管控灵材，一来是因为这是仙教采炁大醮的必备之物，不便流传在外，以免为他人所用。

但炼炁毕竟只是修行第二境，还不用管制甚严，之所以寻常弟子采购不得，乃是因为一次炼炁大醮不成，二次概率微乎其微，若是放任在外，怕是每年要多上许多铤而走险之辈，沦为凡人，于仙教贵生之念不合。

她是真心喜爱陆玄，想要邀他为婿，不愿见他误入歧途。

一旦失败，那就只是一个寻常凡人，怕是八十寿元都不可得。

她不愿女儿经历生死之变。

“人活一世，必有所求。”

“长生不可妄言，但若是炼炁都不可得，岂非蹉跎？”

陆玄再次作揖，语气坚定。

“莫急，不妨看看我给小女准备的嫁妆……”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"A marriage bet?"

Madam Chihuo looked surprised. She was puzzled by these four words at first, but when she saw Lu Xuan lowering his head and his bright eyes, she had a vague guess in her heart.

However, she did not express her guess, but simply asked: "What does this mean?"

Lu Xuan bowed again and said calmly to Madam Chihuo: "Back to Madam, Lu Xuanshi is unwilling to fail and transform into a body of golden armor and jade, so he wants to use his skin to make a bet with Madam."

"I will exchange my body for a [Four-Phase Yarrow] from Madam, and start the Qi Refining Jiao again."

"God's grace is endless. If I fail this time, disaster will surely fall. My cultivation will disappear and there will be no possibility of cultivation in this body. However, refining Qi is the first step in cultivation after all. My life can be saved and my body is not in danger."

"If I fail, I am willing to use my remaining body to join the Fox Clan as my son-in-law until the end of my life."

"If you succeed, repay the favor with kindness."

Lu Xuan's tone was sonorous. It was obvious that he had already known the case and had made up his mind.

With a broken body, I still want to join the Fox Clan as my son-in-law, so I need to ask for a four-phase yarrow in advance?

If it were anyone else, Madam Chihuo would have blasted him away, but looking at the young man standing up and standing in front of her like a orchid and jade tree, she just sighed and persuaded: "Why is this?"

"The method of harvesting qi in the Immortal Teaching is the righteous qi of heaven and earth, which contains the meaning of qi. Those who do not have a wonderful sense of qi cannot collect it..."

"With the method of golden armor and jade body, you can also gain two hundred and sixty years of life, and you can enter the gate of the immortal sect. And with my daughter as your companion, wouldn't it be great to be the companion of the gods and immortals?"

"Why risk it all?"

She has a longer lifespan, so she has a deeper understanding of the Immortal Cult.

The reason why [Four Phases of Yarrow] has become a controlled spiritual material is that it is a must-have for the Immortal Sect's Qi Festival, and it is inconvenient to spread outside to avoid being used by others.

But after all, Qi refining is only the second level of cultivation, and there is no need for strict control. The reason why ordinary disciples are not allowed to purchase it is because the first Qi refining ceremony fails, and the probability of a second refining is very slim. If it is left unchecked, I am afraid that many more desperate people will take risks every year and become mortals, who are not in line with the immortal sect's desire to cherish life.

She really loved Lu Xuan and wanted to ask him to be her son-in-law, but she didn't want to see him go astray.

Once you fail, you will be just an ordinary mortal, and you may not even be able to live eighty years.

She didn't want her daughter to go through life and death.

"Everyone must have something they want in life."

"You can't talk nonsense about immortality, but if you can't get it even by refining Qi, isn't it a waste of time?"

Lu Xuan bowed again, his tone firm.

"Don't worry, you might as well take a look at the dowry I prepared for my little girl..."
